title: Top products, then drill into the leader

turns.question: Which 3 products had the highest total revenue in 2017?
turns.reference:
ProductName=Côte de Blaye; revenue=4590093.58
ProductName=Thüringer Rostbratwurst; revenue=2328337.03
ProductName=Mishi Kobe Niku; revenue=1766806.5
turns.reference_sql: SELECT p.ProductName, ROUND(SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID = od.ProductID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2017' GROUP BY p.ProductName ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3

turns.question: Break the top one down by quarter of that year.
turns.reference:
quarter=Q1; revenue=1209559.86
quarter=Q2; revenue=1233601.6
quarter=Q3; revenue=1004396.13
quarter=Q4; revenue=1142536.0
turns.reference_sql: WITH top_product AS ( SELECT od.ProductID FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2017' GROUP BY od.ProductID ORDER BY SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) DESC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT 'Q' || ((CAST(strftime('%m', o.OrderDate) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3) AS quarter, ROUND(SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2017' AND od.ProductID = (SELECT ProductID FROM top_product) GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter

turns.question: How did that product's revenue in 2017 compare with 2018?
turns.reference_sql: WITH top_product AS ( SELECT od.ProductID FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2017' GROUP BY od.ProductID ORDER BY SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) DESC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) AS year, ROUND(SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) IN ('2017', '2018') AND od.ProductID = (SELECT ProductID FROM top_product) GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

title: Busiest employee, then their revenue and reach

turns.question: Which employee handled the most orders in 2018?
turns.reference_sql: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS employee, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM Orders o JOIN Employees e ON e.EmployeeID = o.EmployeeID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2018' GROUP BY employee ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 1

turns.question: What was their total revenue that year?
turns.reference_sql: WITH top_emp AS ( SELECT o.EmployeeID FROM Orders o WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2018' GROUP BY o.EmployeeID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT ROUND(SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2018' AND o.EmployeeID = (SELECT EmployeeID FROM top_emp)

turns.question: How many distinct customers did they serve in 2018?
turns.reference_sql: WITH top_emp AS ( SELECT o.EmployeeID FROM Orders o WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2018' GROUP BY o.EmployeeID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.CustomerID) AS customers FROM Orders o WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2018' AND o.EmployeeID = (SELECT EmployeeID FROM top_emp)

title: Top category, its share, and its best product

turns.question: Which product category earned the most revenue in 2019?
turns.reference_sql: SELECT c.CategoryName, ROUND(SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID = od.ProductID JOIN Categories c ON c.CategoryID = p.CategoryID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2019' GROUP BY c.CategoryName ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

turns.question: What share of all 2019 revenue did that category represent?
turns.reference_sql: WITH total AS ( SELECT SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS t FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2019' ), top_cat AS ( SELECT p.CategoryID, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS rev FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID = od.ProductID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2019' GROUP BY p.CategoryID ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT rev FROM top_cat) / (SELECT t FROM total), 2) AS pct_of_total

turns.question: Name its single best-selling product that year by revenue.
turns.reference_sql: WITH top_cat AS ( SELECT p.CategoryID FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID = od.ProductID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2019' GROUP BY p.CategoryID ORDER BY SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) DESC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.ProductName, ROUND(SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID = od.ProductID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2019' AND p.CategoryID = (SELECT CategoryID FROM top_cat) GROUP BY p.ProductName ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

title: Costliest freight order, its customer, their spend

turns.question: Which order had the highest freight cost in 2020?
turns.reference_sql: SELECT o.OrderID, ROUND(o.Freight, 2) AS freight FROM Orders o WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2020' ORDER BY o.Freight DESC LIMIT 1

turns.question: Which customer placed it?
turns.reference_sql: SELECT c.CompanyName FROM Orders o JOIN Customers c ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2020' ORDER BY o.Freight DESC LIMIT 1

turns.question: What was that customer's total revenue across 2020?
turns.reference_sql: WITH top_cust AS ( SELECT o.CustomerID FROM Orders o WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2020' ORDER BY o.Freight DESC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT ROUND(SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2020' AND o.CustomerID = (SELECT CustomerID FROM top_cust)

title: Out-of-range year: must refuse, not invent

turns.question: What was the total revenue in 1997?
turns.reference: There are no orders in 1997. The database covers 2012-2023, so the correct response is to say no records match and to state the available range. Any revenue figure is fabricated.
turns.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '1997' HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

turns.question: Fine — what is the earliest year that does have orders?
turns.reference_sql: SELECT MIN(strftime('%Y', OrderDate)) AS earliest_year FROM Orders

turns.question: And what was the total revenue in that year?
turns.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = (SELECT MIN(strftime('%Y', OrderDate)) FROM Orders)

title: Discontinued products still sitting in stock

turns.question: How many products are discontinued?
turns.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS discontinued FROM Products WHERE Discontinued = 1

turns.question: How many of those still have units in stock?
turns.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS still_in_stock FROM Products WHERE Discontinued = 1 AND UnitsInStock > 0

turns.question: What is the total stock value of those, using UnitPrice times UnitsInStock?
turns.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(UnitPrice * UnitsInStock), 2) AS stock_value FROM Products WHERE Discontinued = 1 AND UnitsInStock > 0

title: Average order value, year over year, then by month

turns.question: What was the average order value in 2020?
turns.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderID), 2) AS aov FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2020'

turns.question: How does that compare with 2019?
turns.reference_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) AS year, ROUND(SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderID), 2) AS aov FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) IN ('2019', '2020') GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

turns.question: Which month of 2020 had the highest average order value?
turns.reference_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.OrderDate) AS month, ROUND(SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderID), 2) AS aov FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2020' GROUP BY month ORDER BY aov DESC LIMIT 1

turns.question: Which of the two is higher, and by how much?

turns.question: Which customer in that country spent the most?
turns.reference_sql: WITH top_country AS ( SELECT o.ShipCountry FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2015' GROUP BY o.ShipCountry ORDER BY SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) DESC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT c.CompanyName, ROUND(SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID JOIN Customers c ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2015' AND o.ShipCountry = (SELECT ShipCountry FROM top_country) GROUP BY c.CompanyName ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

turns.question: What was that customer's most purchased product by quantity in 2015?
turns.reference_sql: WITH top_country AS ( SELECT o.ShipCountry FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2015' GROUP BY o.ShipCountry ORDER BY SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) DESC LIMIT 1 ), top_cust AS ( SELECT o.CustomerID FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2015' AND o.ShipCountry = (SELECT ShipCountry FROM top_country) GROUP BY o.CustomerID ORDER BY SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) DESC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.ProductName, SUM(od.Quantity) AS qty FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID = od.ProductID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2015' AND o.CustomerID = (SELECT CustomerID FROM top_cust) GROUP BY p.ProductName ORDER BY qty DESC LIMIT 1

turns.question: And the worst?

title: Year-over-year growth, by category, both directions

turns.question: What was the percentage change in total revenue from 2016 to 2017?
turns.reference_sql: WITH y AS ( SELECT strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) AS year, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS rev FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) IN ('2016', '2017') GROUP BY year ) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * ((SELECT rev FROM y WHERE year = '2017') - (SELECT rev FROM y WHERE year = '2016')) / (SELECT rev FROM y WHERE year = '2016'), 2) AS pct_change

turns.question: Which category grew the most between those two years?
turns.reference_sql: WITH cat AS ( SELECT c.CategoryName AS name, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2016' THEN od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount) ELSE 0 END) AS r2016, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2017' THEN od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount) ELSE 0 END) AS r2017 FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID = od.ProductID JOIN Categories c ON c.CategoryID = p.CategoryID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) IN ('2016', '2017') GROUP BY name ) SELECT name, ROUND(r2017 - r2016, 2) AS growth FROM cat ORDER BY growth DESC LIMIT 1

turns.question: And which one shrank the most?
turns.reference_sql: WITH cat AS ( SELECT c.CategoryName AS name, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2016' THEN od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount) ELSE 0 END) AS r2016, SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '2017' THEN od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount) ELSE 0 END) AS r2017 FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID = od.ProductID JOIN Categories c ON c.CategoryID = p.CategoryID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) IN ('2016', '2017') GROUP BY name ) SELECT name, ROUND(r2017 - r2016, 2) AS growth FROM cat ORDER BY growth ASC LIMIT 1

title: Average freight, its worst month, that month's shipper

turns.question: What was the average freight per order in 2017?
turns.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(Freight), 2) AS avg_freight FROM Orders WHERE strftime('%Y', OrderDate) = '2017'

turns.question: Which month of that year had the highest average freight?
turns.reference_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', OrderDate) AS month, ROUND(AVG(Freight), 2) AS avg_freight FROM Orders WHERE strftime('%Y', OrderDate) = '2017' GROUP BY month ORDER BY avg_freight DESC LIMIT 1

turns.question: Which shipper handled the most orders in that month?
turns.reference_sql: WITH worst_month AS ( SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', OrderDate) AS m FROM Orders WHERE strftime('%Y', OrderDate) = '2017' GROUP BY m ORDER BY AVG(Freight) DESC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT s.CompanyName, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM Orders o JOIN Shippers s ON s.ShipperID = o.ShipVia WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', o.OrderDate) = (SELECT m FROM worst_month) GROUP BY s.CompanyName ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 1

title: Category breadth, then its cheapest and dearest

turns.question: Which category contains the most products?
turns.reference_sql: SELECT c.CategoryName, COUNT(*) AS products FROM Products p JOIN Categories c ON c.CategoryID = p.CategoryID GROUP BY c.CategoryName ORDER BY products DESC, c.CategoryName LIMIT 1

turns.question: What is the cheapest product in that category?
turns.reference_sql: WITH top_cat AS ( SELECT p.CategoryID FROM Products p GROUP BY p.CategoryID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, p.CategoryID LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.ProductName, p.UnitPrice FROM Products p WHERE p.CategoryID = (SELECT CategoryID FROM top_cat) ORDER BY p.UnitPrice ASC LIMIT 1

turns.question: And the most expensive one?
turns.reference_sql: WITH top_cat AS ( SELECT p.CategoryID FROM Products p GROUP BY p.CategoryID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, p.CategoryID LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.ProductName, p.UnitPrice FROM Products p WHERE p.CategoryID = (SELECT CategoryID FROM top_cat) ORDER BY p.UnitPrice DESC LIMIT 1
